scripts.name: The thunderbolt
scripts.description: The lightning-strike demo (dotb.szp): the same lab set under the storm — the drama is in the .scd camera and its keyed lights. The .clr material-colour flash tracks are not yet decoded, so the bolt's materials hold their rest colour.
